name: Frame Window Mod
description: Measures the frame window of every input of a GDR replay with the real game physics, shows it as coloured circles while the replay plays, and computes NaNDL precision (L*). S&Q setting: Fast, Accurate or Ultra Fast.

speed-quality.name: S&Q (Speed and Quality)
speed-quality.description: The main setting. Fast & Medium: saved game states at quiet moments + early pass (the v0.2 behaviour). Slow & Accurate: no saved states, no early pass, validation of at least 15 s and a gap scan behind failing shifts. Ultra Fast & Inaccurate: saved states at ANY tick (also while a button is held), no level restart between trials, short validation; not exact. The settings "Saved game states", "Early pass" and "Control run" below only apply to Fast & Medium.

presses.name: Measure presses
presses.description: Measure the frame window of every press (click).

releases.name: Measure releases
releases.description: Also measure releases. Slower; windows of releases are usually not counted by NaNDL-style precision.

hold-mode.name: Hold handling
hold-mode.description: How a press is moved relative to its release. Auto: short taps (up to 3 ticks, spam) move together with their release, long holds move only the press - avoids fake 1-frame windows in tap sections. Keep hold: always move the whole click. Press only: only the press moves.

full-completion.name: Validate to completion
full-completion.description: Each candidate must complete the whole level. Exact but slower. Off: the candidate must survive the validation horizon.

horizon.name: Validation horizon (s)
horizon.description: Seconds the run must survive after the moved input (ignored when validating to completion). Longer is safer for inputs whose mistakes show up late.

max-window.name: Max window
max-window.description: Stop searching once the window is known to exceed this many ticks (the value is then shown as 'N+'). Larger = more exact, slower.

snapshots.name: Saved game states (Fast & Medium)
snapshots.description: Start every trial from a saved game state taken shortly before the input instead of replaying the level from 0%. Verified by a self-test and by control runs; if the game does not restore states exactly the mod switches back to full replays on its own.

fast-validate.name: Early pass (Fast & Medium)
fast-validate.description: End a trial as soon as the run is identical to the original again for half a second. Much faster in cube sections; turn off if you want every trial to run for the whole validation horizon.

control-every.name: Control run every N inputs (Fast & Medium)
control-every.description: Re-run the unmodified replay from a saved state every N inputs to detect drift (0 = off). Costs about 1/N extra trials.

repeats.name: Repeats per candidate
repeats.description: Run every candidate this many times; inputs where results disagree are marked unstable (random triggers etc.).

from-input.name: From input #
from-input.description: First input number to analyze (1 = first).

to-input.name: To input #
to-input.description: Last input number to analyze (0 = until the end).

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: How fast the simulation runs. Max uses about 12 ms of every frame.

time-budget.name: Time per frame (ms)
time-budget.description: Milliseconds of every rendered frame spent on the analysis at Max speed. Higher = faster analysis, lower frame rate while it runs.

mute.name: Mute during analysis
mute.description: Silence music and effects while the analysis runs (every trial restarts the level).

input-phase.name: Input phase
input-phase.description: When inputs are applied inside a physics step. Auto picks 'After commands' for Mega Hack replays. Change it if Verify fails on a replay that is known to be good.

p-respawn.name: Precision: respawn (s)
p-respawn.description: Time between a death and the next attempt, added to every input time.

p-target.name: Precision: target time (s)
p-target.description: Expected time to complete the level that L* is solved for (86400 = 24 hours).

p-kt.name: Precision: Nerve k_T
p-kt.description: Time-dependent nerve constant (default calibrated by NaN GD / Frame Window Counter).

p-releases.name: Precision: include releases
p-releases.description: Use release windows as inputs in the L* model too.

viewer-keep.name: Replay circles: seconds on screen
viewer-keep.description: How long the coloured circle of a click / release stays visible while watching a replay.

viewer-tick.name: Replay circles: show tick
viewer-tick.description: Also write the tick (frame) number under every circle.
